evidence_quotes.agenda: Before we go over pricing structure and estimate, do you have any question? Any clarification regarding the moving process in general?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No. -- the agenda question drew nothing to dig into (asked twice, both times 'No'), so full credit applies per the no-concern-raised rule
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: if the move goes faster than what we have expected, anticipated, then of course, you pay less. We just wanna give you a realistic worst case number, not be surprised by a higher total later on

top_strength: Hit both damage coverage and Meet Your Mover cleanly, then delivered a fully personalized anchor estimate (16th-floor walk, elevator, town home distance) with a clear window/pay-less-if-faster explanation.
coaching_note: Asked the identical 'any questions about the process' line twice back to back (Process Discipline ding), and never used the specific 'does that feel fair' + silence check before moving to the close.
grading_note: two_layers_deep scored 15 via the no-concern-raised rule; a later billing clarification about the transportation fee was treated as an estimate-stage Q&A, not a Stage 1 concern.
